name: tx402-workspace
description: Development workspace for tx402 — resilient x402 buyer SDK. Not published.
pnpmComment_overrides: @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers (S8, O8) pulls @types/node@24 transitively via wrangler; without this pin pnpm builds TWO vitest@2.1.9 peer-variants (one per @types/node), which the pool reports as 'multiple vitest versions installed' and fails the DO Workers-runtime suite. Pin @types/node to the repo's declared v20 line so vitest dedupes to one instance.

scripts.check: pnpm toolchain:check && pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm nul-check && pnpm workflow-lint && pnpm version:check && pnpm install-contract && pnpm conformance:check && pnpm conformance:selftest && pnpm manifest:verify && pnpm test && pnpm size && pnpm fuzz && pnpm adversarial && pnpm adversarial:selftest && pnpm durable:selftest && pnpm docs:check && pnpm docs:live:selftest && pnpm supply-chain:selftest && pnpm toolchain:selftest && pnpm docs:build
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm --filter tx402 build && node tools/docs-gen/index.js build
scripts.docs:deploy: pnpm docs:build && pnpm dlx wrangler@4 pages deploy docs/dist --project-name tx402-docs --branch main --commit-dirty=true && node tools/docs-live/index.js check
